total_model.summary: Model projects 41.1 total points (CLE 19, HOU 22). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (lowers total 2.3), Combined offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (raises total 1.2), Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (lowers total 1.2). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
